rule: event = the local flatten readback instant; the bucket is venue income in [event-120s, event+120s]. The event instants were re-derived by solving for the offset at which the v1 COMMISSION count and REALIZED_PNL sum reproduce the published table exactly, so the window is identical to the one the original table used.
why: R15-I1: three of the eight buckets were computed from income pulls that the v1 paged fetcher had truncated at a full-page boundary millisecond. Only those three could move; the other five had no full page and are unchanged.
boundary: the +/-120s window is an ATTRIBUTION CHOICE, not a venue-supplied event grouping; regular non-flatten trades in the same window are included. Unchanged from the original table - this receipt changes the COMPLETENESS of the input, not the attribution rule.

correction_2026_09_19_round16.what_this_does_NOT_establish: zero two-sided trading does NOT make group B pure protective exit. It only rules out HEDGED normal trading.
